title: Victoria: the WP class and the boom-length question
moduleTitle: Optional add-on: high-risk work and platform licences
audience: Workers and supervisors who may be asked to work at height or on a platform. Optional add-on, taken alongside the main courses.
learningOutcomes: Identify the Victorian WP class by its official name.
Distinguish a confirmed class from a boom-length rule that is not confirmed.

instruction.heading: What the Victorian class covers
instruction.body: WorkSafe Victoria's high risk work licence page names a boom-type elevating work platform operation licence as a high risk work licence class (page reviewed 30 June 2026).

instruction.heading: The boom-length question
instruction.body: Whether the Victorian WP licence applies at any boom length is not confirmed by an official source. WorkSafe Victoria's page states the class without a boom length. A page that states no length does not confirm that there is no length threshold.

instruction.heading: What to do
instruction.body: Ask WorkSafe Victoria about the length rule before relying on it, and do not assume a short boom is outside the licence or inside it until the rule is confirmed.

procedure: Confirm the class name on the WorkSafe Victoria page.
Look for a stated boom-length rule; if none is stated, mark the rule as not confirmed.
Ask WorkSafe Victoria before work where the length matters.

workedExamples.situation: A Victorian worker plans a 6 metre boom job and asks whether the WP licence applies.
workedExamples.reasoning: It confirms that the WP class exists in Victoria. It does not confirm whether a 6 metre boom needs the licence, because the Victorian boom-length rule is not confirmed by an official source. Ask WorkSafe Victoria before work.

commonErrors.error: Reading silence on a page as a rule.
commonErrors.prevention: Look for the words of a rule; if the page does not state it, mark it not confirmed.

safetyAndRegulatory.point: The Victorian boom-length rule is not confirmed by an official source. Confirm it with WorkSafe Victoria before relying on it.

qualityStandard: Learner separates the confirmed class name from the unconfirmed length rule.
documentationEvidence: Date of the WorkSafe Victoria page checked and the written answer from the regulator, if sought.
summary: The Victorian WP class is named on the regulator's page.
The Victorian boom-length rule is not confirmed.

knowledgeChecks.question: What is the status of the claim that the Victorian WP licence applies at any boom length?
options: Not confirmed by an official source
Confirmed for booms over 11 metres only

officialReferences.title: High risk work licence (WorkSafe Victoria)
officialReferences.covers: Names the boom-type elevating work platform operation licence class; states the class without a boom length; scissor lifts do not need the WP licence. Does not state whether the class applies at any boom length.
